overall: The Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law: its September 7 notice listing the health agent position met minimum requirements, and the meeting's length was not itself a violation.

allegations.summary: Alleged the Sept. 7 notice's 'Health Agent position—job posting update' topic was too vague because it did not say the Board would consider assigning work tasks to the agent.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the September 7 meeting notice met the minimum requirements of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: To the extent the complaint alleged that the Sept. 7 meeting's length (running past 1:00 A.M.) violated the Open Meeting Law, the AG addressed it in a footnote.
allegations.key_passage: we note that holding a meeting of such duration does not violate G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25.
